##### What We Do
## Security Systems You Can Count On
## We are a Dallas/Fort Worth based Home and Business Security and Fire systems dealer, serving the DFW metroplex.
We have thousands of residential and commercial alarm clients in Weatherford, Fort Worth, Keller, Justin, Alliance, Saginaw, Roanoke, Burleson, Joshua, Mansfield, Arlington, Grapevine, Southlake, Farmers Brand, Addison, Richardson, Plano, Allen, McKinney, Frisco, Little Elm, Garland, Rowlett, Mesquite, Dallas, Midlothian, Waxahachie, Carrollton, Lucas, Prosper, Wylie, and many other areas.
## Our Mission
Our mission is to keep you safe, and we have the tools to do so. We are UL-certified and we are a 5 diamond-rated monitoring company. Even if you feel confident in handling home emergencies yourself, it is always a good idea to have a security system in place. We promise an immediate response in the case of an emergency.
## UL-Certified
We promise 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year(366 days if it’s a leap year) UL-certified monitoring. We provide around-the-clock monitoring for your safety and your home’s maximum security. 
You may be wondering what UL-Certified means and why it is a big deal. UL-Certification means that we and our services have undergone rigid evaluation and have been determined to pass the test of high standards and service. 
UL stands for Underwriters Laboratories, and they are a company dedicated to ensuring security companies are able to provide a high standard of security monitoring. This involves testing and training of our products and the people who help to monitor homes. 
## How can we help you?

#### Home Automation and Smart Home Systems
With years of experience helping residents and businesses throughout the DFW Metroplex, our team is always ready to work with you to find the perfect solutions to meet your needs. Don’t hesitate to contact us right away to schedule a consultation!

## 5 Diamond Monitoring
We are partnered with a 5 Diamond Monitoring Facility. A 5 Diamond Monitoring Facility is dedicated to excellence and random inspections to ensure that the standard remains high.
The 5 Diamond Designation is something that is re-evaluated on a yearly basis to make sure that each company is maintaining its high standards.
Here are the commitments we made to earn the 5 Diamond status:
 * Commitment to random inspections and quality criteria standards by a nationally recognized testing laboratory such as FM Approvals, Intertek/ETL and UL.
 * Commitment to the highest levels of customer service.
 * Commitment to ongoing job-related education and testing by having 100% of its central station operators certified using the TMA online training series.
 * Commitment to raising the industry standards through TMA membership and participation in its activities.
 * Commitment to reducing false dispatches.

Each of these commitments is something we hold close and use as a daily guide on how to better serve the communities we protect.
## Call 360 Alarm Today!
With locations in Grand Prairie and Grapevine, 360 Alarm provides the Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex security and peace of mind. Call today to speak with one of our security experts.
